courseCodes.title: Bachelor of Liberal Arts and Science
Bachelor of Liberal Arts and Science (Honours)

awardRequirements.rawText: To qualify for the award of the pass degree, a student must successfully complete 144 credit points of units of study which must include the requirements of a major from either Science Table A or Arts and Social Sciences Table A. The units of study for this course are selected from the Liberal Studies Table, Science Table A, and Arts and Social Sciences Table A, and where required from Table S, O and D, according to the rules below: 1. Liberal Studies: 36 credit points of Liberal studies units must be completed from the Liberal Studies Table. These must include the core units: ATHK1X01 and WRIT1001, 6 credit points from Part C Ethics and 18 credit points of electives from Parts A-F; and 2. Science: A minimum of 36 credit points of units from Science Table A must be completed. This includes a minimum of 12 credit points at the 2000 or 3000 level; a. If a Science major or program is completed, this requirement will be satisfied by the requirements for that major or program. b. If an Arts and Social Science major is completed, the units counted towards this Science requirement can be any combination of units listed in Science Table A that includes a minimum of 12 credit points at the 2000 or 3000 level and may complete a major or minor from Science Table A; and 3. Arts and Social Sciences: A minimum of 36 credit points of units of study from Arts and Social Science Table A must be completed. This includes a minimum of 12 credit points at the 2000 or 3000 level. a. If an Arts and Social Sciences major is completed this requirement will be satisfied by the requirements for that major. b. If a Science major or program is being completed, units counted towards Arts and Social Sciences can be any combination of units listed in Arts and Social Sciences Table A that includes a minimum of 12 credit points at the 2000 or 3000 level and may complete a major or minor from Arts & Social Sciences Table A; and 4. Electives: additional units of study to bring the total credit points completed for the degree to 144 credit points selected from: a. Table S, which includes units from Science, Arts and Social Sciences, and other faculties in the University; and b. Table O – a maximum of 12 credit points; and c. Table D - for students in the Dalyell stream only, a minimum of 12 credit points of Dalyell units of study as specified in Table D 5. Students must complete no more than 84 credit points of 1000-level units of study. 6. No double-counting: Any given unit of study can only be counted once towards the degree requirements. For example, a unit of study counted towards the Liberal Studies requirement cannot also count towards the Arts and Social Sciences requirement or the Science requirement.
